prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a low-speed head-on collision in League City, Texas, and has neck strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1295; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather not give my full name on the recording, but I can confirm I'm the driver of the vehicle involved in the accident.

Q: That's fine. Can you describe what happened on the day of the collision?

A: I was driving on a two-lane road in League City, heading toward the shopping center. The other car came over into my lane while it was rounding a curve. I braked and turned slightly, but we still hit nose to nose. It wasn't a hard hit, but it was enough to jolt me.

Q: What was your approximate speed at the time of impact?

A: I'd say maybe fifteen or twenty miles an hour. I wasn't going fast. I had just slowed down for the curve.

Q: Were you wearing your seatbelt?

A: Yes, I was. The airbags did not deploy, but the belt definitely held me in place.

Q: Did you feel any injuries immediately after the accident?

A: Not right away. I felt a little shaken up, but I thought I was okay. By that evening my neck was stiff and sore, and when I turned my head to the left it caught. The next morning it was worse, and I had a headache that started at the base of my skull.

Q: Have you sought medical treatment since the accident?

A: Yes, I went to an urgent care clinic two days later, and I've been referred to a physical therapist. They diagnosed a neck strain. I'm still doing the exercises and taking over-the-counter pain relievers.

Q: Is there anything else you would like to add to your statement?

A: Only that I want to get my car repaired and my neck back to normal. I've been cooperative and I'm willing to provide any records you need.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
